item.zxkstudio.antidoto_ambar.lore1: An ancient serum distilled from amber and sap.
message.zxkstudio.graft.fail.not_strippe: Strip the log with an axe first
message.zxkstudio.graft.fail.blocked: That side of the log is taken
message.zxkstudio.graft.fail.no_mud: The tree base must stand on mud
message.zxkstudio.graft.fail.no_water: Not enough water near the tree base
item.zxkstudio.sirenia_seed.desc1: A germ from an ancient aquatic tree.
item.zxkstudio.sirenia_seed.desc2: Right-click the side of a stripped Sirenia log.
item.zxkstudio.sirenia_seed.desc3: The tree base must stand on mud with water nearby.
item.zxkstudio.sirenia_fruit.desc2: Breathe, mine and swim better underwater, and see farther.
item.zxkstudio.sirenia_fruit.desc3: Out of the water you drown.
item.zxkstudio.wilted_sirenia_fruit.desc: Wilted: grants Sirenomorphosis for a shorter time.
Out of the water you drown.
item.zxkstudio.rotten_sirenia_fruit.desc: Cyan screen, light-blue hearts and constant damage (it won't kill you).
Only cured by eating a Sirenia Heart in good condition.
block.zxkstudio.sirenia_log.desc1: Ancient deep-blue wood with turquoise veins.
block.zxkstudio.sirenia_log.desc2: Strip it with an axe to graft onto it.
block.zxkstudio.stripped_sirenia_log.des: Up to 4 fruits, one per side.
block.zxkstudio.stripped_sirenia_wood.de: Stripped wood: also accepts Sirenia Germs.
block.zxkstudio.sirenia_leaves.desc1: Blue-green leaves of the Sirenia Tree.
block.zxkstudio.sirenia_leaves.desc2: With luck they drop a Sirenia Germ.
